sn1.26:1.1: Kati lokasmiṃ pajjotā || yehi loko pakāsati. || bhavantaṃ puṭṭhum āgamma || kathaṃ jānemu taṃ mayan ti || ||
sn1.26:2.1: Cattāro loke pajjotā || pañcam-etthana vijjati || divā tapati ādicco || rattim ābhāti candimā || ||
sn1.26:3.1: atha aggi divārattiṃ || tattha tattha pabhāsati || sambuddho tapataṃ seṭṭho || esā ābhā anuttarā ti || ||
